token_grammar.substitution: one-pass exact token replacement from descriptor-admitted roots and internally joined products; unresolved, repeated, nested, relative, NUL, dot-dot, or symlink-resolving values reject

token_values.REPOSITORY_ROOT: descriptor-admitted implementation root used only by P00 to hold the exact producer source, by the separately committed predecessor-tools build envelope, and by B00 source-view construction; never a compiler cwd and never inspected by a runtime Git process
token_values.SOURCE_ROOT: P01.source_view_root; the sole compilation and test source tree
token_values.PRODUCER_PREP_A: P00.root_A.path; first fresh non-authoritative predecessor-producer preparation root
token_values.PRODUCER_PREP_B: P00.root_B.path; second fresh non-authoritative predecessor-producer preparation root
token_values.PREDECESSOR_A: T00.root_A.path; first fresh predecessor-tools build-only root
token_values.PREDECESSOR_B: T00.root_B.path; second fresh predecessor-tools build-only root

predecessor_producer_preparation_root_la.construction_sequence: explicit admitted bootstrap boundary exclusively creates two empty 0700 descriptor-held roots; records exact empty initial inventories; arms and drains root-identity plus held-parent entry watches before any entry creation; creates only the fixed pre-action entries and module-cache children by descriptor-rooted no-follow fixed-arity operations; descriptor-reconstructs both pre-action inventories; holds exact producer source bytes from the committed implementation and sends those same bytes to each compiler stdin then EOF; keeps roots and output descriptors held through pair comparison result encoding and final revalidation; any deviation is retained P00 failure
predecessor_producer_preparation_root_la.source_transport: exact held Tools/H2LivePredecessorToolsBuilder/main.c bytes on compiler stdin with -x c -; stdin byte count SHA256 and EOF are process-derived and must equal P00.producer_source

predecessor_tools_root_layout.construction_sequence: exclusive_no_replace_create_root_A_then_root_B; descriptor-reconstruct each exact empty inventory; arm and drain both root-identity and held-parent entry watches; create only entries_exact_pre_actions with descriptor-rooted fixed-arity no-follow operations; create only module_cache_entries_exact and input_directories_exact; copy the two descriptor-held implementation source byte strings into each exact input leaf using exclusive fixed-arity descriptor-rooted writes, fsync, chmod 0400, reopen O_NOFOLLOW, arm file and held-input-parent watches, drain, and revalidate device inode bytes SHA256 Git-blob nlink owner mode; descriptor-reconstruct root_A_pre_actions and root_B_pre_actions; drain all root parent input-file and input-parent watches again; any deviation is retained failure and no action enters

git_object_reconstruction.nested_tree_rule: reconstruct_every_directory_bottom_up_from_the_complete_ordered_tracked_tree_entries; an implementation tree containing any entry not represented by ordered_source_files is a hard failure

merkle.file_leaf_payload: canonical sorted-key JSON of the exact entry map

source_continuity.source_view_materialization: the bootstrap supervisor decodes and exactly reencodes EPRH2B00, descriptor-holds every B00 ordered source file O_NOFOLLOW, recomputes exact bytes SHA256 Git blob IDs every nested Git tree and the manifest root, then exclusively materializes exactly those regular files and containing directories beneath ${BOOTSTRAP_A}/source-view; no .git, untracked, ignored, symlink, gitlink, special, hardlink, or extra entry is admitted
source_continuity.repository_status_scope: UNASSESSED_AND_NONAUTHORITATIVE; no Git process is launched and repository untracked ignored or dirty state cannot enter the B00-defined source view
source_continuity.descriptor_inventory: hold every materialized source-view file and every containing directory from source-view root through leaf; reject symlink, special file, path escape, duplicate vnode, count overflow, mode/blob/hash mismatch, or extra entry
source_continuity.root_identity_continuity: hold the source-view root and its bootstrap-A parent; watch identity events on the root and entry changes on the parent; require named-pre descriptor named-post device/inode joins and zero identity events in P01 and B01
source_continuity.arm_gap_closure: register every held file and directory, drain once, recompute every descriptor hash/git blob/named vnode and source manifest, then drain again; either drain nonempty rejects before first action
source_continuity.during_actions: continuously drain; any event permanently poisons the build result
source_continuity.final_join: first drain, recompute every descriptor hash/git blob/named vnode and source manifest, then final drain; either drain nonempty rejects

each_bootstrap_or_product_root.entry_count_metric: count every descriptor-rooted descendant directory entry excluding the root itself; do not follow symlinks; an unreadable, raced, symlink, or special entry rejects
each_bootstrap_or_product_root.aggregate_allocated_bytes_metric: sum UInt64(st_blocks) multiplied by 512 for every counted entry using its no-follow stat result; a hard-linked duplicate vnode is counted for the sample and then rejects the inventory; integer overflow rejects
each_bootstrap_or_product_root.aggregate_logical_bytes_metric: sum UInt64(st_size) for every regular file using the same no-follow inventory; integer overflow or any observation above the ceiling rejects

resource_bounds.enforcement: measure descriptor-rooted inventory before each action, sample every 100 milliseconds while an action is unreaped, and remeasure after exact reap; record timebase first/last/sample count/maximum gap/maximum scan duration and require coverage of the full unreaped interval; an incomplete or late scan or measured excess permanently rejects the build slice and enters only the already-frozen containment path
resource_bounds.sampling_overshoot_residual: writes completed between samples can temporarily exceed a ceiling; final inventory is still mandatory and no PASS is available after any observed excess

root_inventory_merkle.scope: descriptor-rooted complete descendant topology without following symlinks; root entry itself is excluded from leaves and is joined separately by path device inode owner and mode
root_inventory_merkle.entry_order: raw UTF-8 relative-path bytes lexicographic ascending unique nonempty no leading slash dot or dot-dot component
root_inventory_merkle.allocated_bytes: UInt64(st_blocks) multiplied by 512 with checked arithmetic
root_inventory_merkle.aggregate_logical_bytes: checked sum of regular-file byte_count fields; directories contribute zero
root_inventory_merkle.leaf_payload: canonical sorted-key JSON encoding of the exact typed entry map
root_inventory_merkle.rejection: symlink special unreadable raced path duplicate relative path duplicate vnode arithmetic overflow or count/byte ceiling breach

action_transport.scope: the common success observation shape applies to all six P01 bootstrap actions and all fourteen B01 build actions; P01 actions are actuated only by the separately enveloped bootstrap supervisor and B01 actions are actuated only by the outer build launcher
action_transport.spawn: the owning supervisor or launcher posix_spawns the held physical executable image suspended with explicit replacement environment, descriptor cwd, CLOEXEC default, fixed logical argv[0], and one private action process group; the B01 controller has zero spawn sites and may request only the next frozen ordinal
action_transport.image_join_before_resume: hold the physical executable O_NOFOLLOW; require named/descriptor SHA256 UUID device inode equality; double-snapshot direct child generation; join mapped main image device/inode to held physical descriptor; then one positive-PID SIGCONT
action_transport.pipes: independent nonblocking stdout and stderr drains start before resume; parent write ends close immediately; each stream retains at most 16777216 bytes then discards to EOF while setting overflow; PASS requires both EOF and no overflow
action_transport.resource_observation: every action record carries timebase first/last/sample-count/max-gap/max-scan-duration full-interval coverage allocated-and-logical byte ceilings observed peaks post-reap values and an exceeded flag for that role's ACTION_ROOT; action PASS requires cadence and every ceiling predicate
action_transport.root_identity_continuity: before resume and after reap the actuator joins ACTION_ROOT named and held device/inode, holds its parent, drains the schema-frozen masks for root identity and parent entry watches, and records descriptor-rooted inventories; root NOTE_WRITE and NOTE_EXTEND are deliberately excluded from the identity mask because expected child content changes are measured by descriptor inventories and resource samples
action_transport.wait: the owning actuator performs exact direct-child waitpid and two signal-zero ESRCH observations for the action PGID; ordinary action deadline is followed by at most 30 seconds for containment and exact reap, after which only a bounded incomplete outer receipt is permitted
action_transport.failure_closure: close every created descriptor on every pre-spawn, pre-resume, and post-spawn failure path
action_transport.pre_resume_reject: after successful spawn but before full generation/image join, the owning actuator may enter at most one positive-PID SIGKILL against only the exact unreaped PID returned by its own spawn; exact waitpid is mandatory and no identity claim follows
action_transport.timeout: the controller enters no signal; the launcher is already the parent and owner of every B01 action from posix_spawn return; immediately before any negative-PGID SIGKILL it performs two fresh matching generation snapshots and a bounded membership census, otherwise enters no signal and retains INCOMPLETE; every request, signal status, reap, drain, and ESRCH result is included in EPRH2O01

outer_selected_controller_launch.launch_envelope: separate committed record pins P01 frame SHA256, selected controller SHA256 UUID device inode, source-view root device inode, this plan SHA256, and replacement_environment after ACTION_ROOT=${PRODUCT_A} expansion
outer_selected_controller_launch.spawn: launcher owns the controller and every requested build action posix_spawn from syscall return; all children begin suspended in private PGIDs with descriptor cwd explicit replacement environment and bounded independent drains
outer_selected_controller_launch.mapped_join_before_resume: double-snapshot generation plus selected descriptor/named/mapped SHA256 UUID device inode equality
outer_selected_controller_launch.pre_signal_rejoin: immediately before each negative-PGID signal entry take two libproc snapshots and require exact pid start-time session parent pgid mapped-image identity equality plus a bounded group-membership census proving every observed member descends from the launcher-owned action or controller generation; mismatch means zero signal and INCOMPLETE
outer_selected_controller_launch.timeout_order: if an action group is active, freshly rejoin and contain that exact group first, reap and prove two ESRCH observations; then freshly rejoin and contain the controller group, reap, drain, and classify outer INCOMPLETE
outer_selected_controller_launch.outer_receipt: the launcher emits exactly one canonical EPRH2O01 terminal receipt binding B00/O00/P01/plan hashes launcher and controller named-descriptor-mapped identities every Q01/K01/A02/S01 frame object and digest every fresh pre-signal snapshot and membership census failed action signals exact reaps pipe EOFs group probes and the exact B01 frame hash or absence
outer_selected_controller_launch.terminal: exact controller reap, both pipe EOFs, no active action generation, and two controller-PGID ESRCH observations; timeout or invalid/missing EPRH2B01 yields bounded EPRH2O01 INCOMPLETE and never a B01 PASS; at the absolute horizon close captures emit the retained bounded receipt and exit without retry or further signal
residuals: descendants that independently leave the inherited private PGID are not kernel-confined or claimed absent
a SIGKILL-entered exact process or group that remains observable at the finite absolute horizon is retained as INCOMPLETE and is not waited on indefinitely by the launcher

native_operations_in_order.source: exact release A or B after pair equality

operator_semantics.canonical_paths_have_no_equality_or_ance: each UTF-8 absolute path must equal descriptor-rooted realpath bytes, contain no empty dot or dot-dot component and no trailing slash, then every unordered pair must differ and neither canonical component sequence may be a prefix of the other
operator_semantics.device_inode_tuples_pairwise_distinct: each operand is exactly a two-element decimal-string tuple [device,inode] already joined to its held root observation; every unordered tuple pair must differ

predecessor_producer_build_observation_t.recipe_join: each observation position role actuator compiler_path argv cwd deadline and exact replacement environment equal the same-index plan action after exact token expansion
predecessor_producer_build_observation_t.compiler_image_join: compiler_named_device equals descriptor_device equals nonnull mapped_device; compiler_named_inode equals descriptor_inode equals nonnull mapped_inode; compiler_all_joins true; compiler SHA256 and UUID equal the descriptor and mapped image; both observations use the same physical compiler SHA256 UUID and vnode
predecessor_producer_build_observation_t.generation_observation: spawn_status is retained and equals zero; spawn_returned_pid is retained; generation_snapshot_A and generation_snapshot_B are both retained complete raw processGenerationSnapshot objects; generation_snapshots_equal and pid_double_snapshot_equal are true only when the two objects compare field-for-field equal; flattened pid parent_pid session_id start_seconds start_microseconds pgid equal both raw snapshots; both mapped image identities equal the held compiler named descriptor SHA256 UUID vnode; parent_pid remains observational because P00 outer capture owns no process authority
predecessor_producer_build_observation_t.stdin_join: stdin_byte_count equals producer_source.byte_count; stdin_sha256 equals producer_source.sha256; exactly those held bytes are written once then stdin_eof_sent true; argv contains the exact adjacent -x c - triple and no source path argument
predecessor_producer_build_observation_t.time_join: start_continuous_ticks is strictly less than or equal to end_continuous_ticks and deadline_continuous_ticks equals start plus the mach-timebase conversion of exactly 300 seconds; action B does not enter before action A end and exact reap
predecessor_producer_build_observation_t.wait_join: wait_target_pid equals spawn_returned_pid equals flattened pid equals both generation snapshot pids; wait_returned_pid equals wait_target_pid; wait_errno equals zero; wait_status is the raw waitpid status word and exit_status is exact WIFEXITED/WEXITSTATUS decoding equal zero; exact_reap true; no absence of descendants or process-group conservation is inferred
predecessor_producer_build_observation_t.capture_join: stdout_prefix_hex and stderr_prefix_hex hex-decode to their recorded byte counts and exact SHA256 values; on pass both are empty with EOF true overflow false and outer_capture_complete true
predecessor_producer_build_observation_t.manual_boundary: manual_intervention_entered false on pass; signals_entered is globally zero; CPU RSS FD process-count and energy remain UNMEASURED_BOOTSTRAP_TRUST_BOUNDARY while descriptor-rooted inventories are exact; descendant containment remains unproven even when the direct compiler is exactly reaped
predecessor_producer_build_observation_t.output_join: after exact direct-child reap each output is opened O_NOFOLLOW and held and an output-vnode watch is armed; expected root child path device inode named-post device inode owner mode 0700 nlink1 descriptor-held byte count allocated bytes SHA256 UUID load commands CodeDirectory and expanded settings are recorded in producer_A_or_B; immediately before payload encoding the watch is drained with zero events and named path plus held descriptor are rejoined while terminal byte_count SHA256 UUID equal the recorded image; this is a point-in-time pre-encoding observation only and T00 performs independent named descriptor mapped re-admission

predecessor_producer_source_membership_j.membership_rule: exactly one B00 ordered_source_files member has path_exact and every named field equals P00.producer_source; B00 implementation_commit and implementation_tree equal P00; B00 complete nested Git tree reconstruction therefore closes the later full-tree membership join without a runtime Git process during P00

predecessor_producer_preparation_failure.prefix_rule: each count denotes an exact nonnull A_then_B prefix and every remaining nullable field is null; build_observations length equals completed_build_count and is the exact A_then_B recipe prefix; last_completed_position is null iff completed_build_count is zero and otherwise equals completed_build_count minus one
predecessor_producer_preparation_failure.failed_build_rule: failed_build is nonnull exactly when failed_build_entered and has position equal completed_build_count with the exact next recipe; it is a predecessorProducerFailedBuildTranscript governed by failed_build_subphase_availability and cannot coexist with completed_build_count two

failed_build_subphase_availability.common: spawn_status is the raw posix_spawn return code and spawn_entered is true exactly when spawn_status is zero and spawn_returned_pid is nonnull; generation_snapshot_count equals the exact nonnull A-then-B prefix length; generation_snapshots_equal is null until count two and thereafter equals the field-for-field raw comparison; every positive wait target or returned pid equals spawn_returned_pid; stdout and stderr prefix hex byte counts SHA256 EOF and overflow describe only bytes actually captured
failed_build_subphase_availability.available_prefix_hash: available_prefix_sha256 equals SHA256 of the canonical sorted-key JSON encoding of every predecessorProducerFailedBuildTranscript field except available_prefix_sha256 itself in exact schema field spelling while retaining every explicit null; no self-hash placeholder omission or prose-derived field is allowed

predecessor_producer_preparation_failure.pair_and_selection_rule: producer_pair is nonnull exactly when pair_available; selected_producer is nonnull exactly when producer_pair satisfies pairIdentityPass; mismatching pair evidence is retained with null selection
predecessor_producer_preparation_failure.image_hold_rule: producer_images_terminal_revalidation_complete is true exactly when both producer_A and producer_B are nonnull their output file watches are armed with zero events and their terminal named descriptor byte-count SHA256 UUID joins pass immediately before payload encoding; P00 makes no post-encoding byte-continuity claim and T00 independently reopens rehashes and joins the selected named descriptor mapped image before any action
predecessor_producer_preparation_failure.root_retention_rule: roots_retained is true exactly when initial_root_count is nonzero and every created root remains; roots_pairwise_disjoint is nonnull only after both initial roots are observed and true only after canonical no-ancestry plus vnode-distinct joins
predecessor_producer_preparation_failure.horizon_rule: signals_entered is always zero; outer capture stops waiting and returns retained failure by 660 seconds; because descendant containment is explicitly unproven any surviving host process is managed outside P00 and cannot make the result pass or be reinterpreted

predecessor_producer_root_continuity_joi.watch_lifetime: root identity and held-parent entry watches arm after exact empty initial observation and before layout; remain armed through both compiler intervals pair audit selection result encoding and final revalidation

predecessor_tools_action_prefix_table.failure_prefix_rule: T00.actions length equals failure.completed_action_count and is the exact actionPass prefix at positions zero through count-minus-one; last_completed_position is null exactly when count is zero and otherwise equals count-minus-one
predecessor_tools_action_prefix_table.failed_action_rule: failed_action is nonnull exactly for failure.phase action, its action_position and role equal the next plan position and failure.failed_action_position, and completed_action_count is 0 through 3; all other phases require both failed_action and failed_action_position null
predecessor_tools_action_prefix_table.parent_and_sequence_rule: each entered compiler driver's parent_pid equals T00.producer_generation.pid; every completed action is a double-snapshotted generation-joined direct child in a private pgid-equals-pid group; the partial failed action claims only the ownership fields made available by predecessor_failed_action_phase_availability_table; no action n+1 enters before action n exact reap and two ESRCH group probes

predecessor_failed_action_phase_availabi.generation_join_rule: when generation_snapshot_count is two, A and B either compare byte-for-byte equal and pgid_joined may be true only after direct-child pid parent session start-time pgid and mapped-image joins, or mismatch and pgid_joined is false; fewer than two observations can never claim a generation or group join
predecessor_failed_action_phase_availabi.pipe_prefix_rule: stdout_prefix_hex and stderr_prefix_hex decode to the recorded byte counts, their SHA256 values hash exactly those bytes, overflow booleans are exact, and EOF is nullable until observed; raw_pipes_exact_empty_unresumed means zero bytes empty SHA256 empty hex EOF null and overflow false
predecessor_failed_action_phase_availabi.signal_rule: exactly one receipt may exist: before a certified group join it is positivePidKillReceipt against only the returned direct-child pid with no generation/group authority claim; after a certified private group join it is launcherSignalReceipt against only that group; no signal availability fabricates delivery or absence
predecessor_failed_action_phase_availabi.action_rule: a nonnull action is permitted only in reap_capture and every field equals the corresponding available observation and exact plan position; it need not satisfy actionPass and cannot enter T00.actions
predecessor_failed_action_phase_availabi.prefix_hash_rule: available_prefix_sha256 equals SHA256 of canonical sorted-key JSON of every predecessorFailedActionTranscript field except available_prefix_sha256, retaining explicit nulls and booleans

predecessor_tools_action_pass_table.output_join_rule: after each exact-reap action and before any later action, descriptor-open the exact output O_NOFOLLOW and record its device inode named-post device inode owner mode 0700 nlink1 descriptor-held byte count allocated bytes SHA256 UUID load-command CodeDirectory and expanded-build-settings hashes; device equals named-post device and inode equals named-post inode; that observation is the next member of the built-image prefix

predecessor_tools_failure_availability_t.prefix_rule: for every named count except source_copy_count the first count fields are nonnull exact observations and every remaining field is null; source_copy_count is the flattened A0 A1 B0 B1 prefix length, source_copies_A length equals min(count,2), source_copies_B length equals max(count-2,0), and no array hole exists; actions and last_completed_position obey predecessor_tools_action_prefix_table
predecessor_tools_failure_availability_t.pair_and_selection_rule: capture_launcher_pair is nonnull exactly when capture_pair_available; selected_capture_launcher is nonnull exactly when that pair is available and is pairIdentityPass; bootstrap_supervisor_pair and selected_bootstrap_supervisor follow the same rule; a mismatching available pair is retained with raw_equal false and has null selection
predecessor_tools_failure_availability_t.final_root_rule: final_root_count may be zero through initial_root_count after any failure and is an exact A-then-B prefix captured after containment; roots_retained is true exactly when initial_root_count is nonzero and every created root is left in place, otherwise false
predecessor_tools_failure_availability_t.containment_rule: entered_compiler_driver_actions equals completed_action_count plus one exactly when failed_action.available_observation.spawn_entered; signals_entered equals the count of entered nonnull failed-action signal receipts and is at most one; all_entered_direct_children_exactly_reaped reflects exact observations and may be false only with a retained finite-horizon failure, never a fabricated absence

predecessor_producer_distribution_exclus.source_join: pbx_project_path equals ErgenticsProvenance.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj and exactly one B00.ordered_source_files member at that path has pbx_project_sha256 and pbx_project_git_blob equal to its SHA256 and Git blob while B01 source continuity proves the held source bytes unchanged

algorithm.input: exact held project.pbxproj bytes joined to B00
algorithm.parser: closed non-importing OpenStep ASCII property-list parser rejects duplicate object identifiers duplicate dictionary keys malformed comments escapes strings arrays dictionaries or trailing bytes
algorithm.unsupported_constructs: fail closed before inventory PASS if any PBXFileSystemSynchronizedRootGroup PBXFileSystemSynchronizedBuildFileExceptionSet PBXShellScriptBuildPhase PBXBuildRule or other executable or implicit-membership construct is present; extending support requires a successor protocol freeze
algorithm.reachability: enumerate every PBX object; for each application target traverse buildPhases files fileRef productReference dependencies packageProductDependencies and target-linked helper or XPC relationships; also enumerate every object whose path name productName or productReference contains the excluded filename even when unreachable
algorithm.entry_encoding: canonical sorted-key JSON object with exactly ordinal object_id isa scope owning_target_id owning_target_name path_or_name source_tree excluded_filename_match and no trailing LF
algorithm.ordering: strict ascending unsigned UTF8 byte order by scope then owning_target_id_or_empty then object_id then path_or_name; ordinal is the zero-based array index; duplicate tuples reject

signed_audit_join_table.frame: decode EPRH2A01 magic and 8-lowercase-hex length, require exact payload length, canonical JSON exact reencode, no trailing bytes, SHA256 exact frame bytes

predecessor_root_continuity_join_table.watch_lifetime: both root identity and held-parent entry watches arm after exact empty initial observations and before any layout child creation; remain armed across deterministic layout construction, all four action intervals, pair audits, selection, and final descriptor/named revalidation

predecessor_source_copy_continuity_join_.source_joins: each implementation_path selects exactly one B00 ordered_source_files entry; byte_count SHA256 and git_blob equal that entry; capture copies SHA256 equal T00.capture_launcher_source_sha256; supervisor copies SHA256 equal T00.bootstrap_supervisor_source_sha256; corresponding A and B source-copy byte_count SHA256 and git_blob values equal
predecessor_source_copy_continuity_join_.root_and_parent_joins: each path is the exact descriptor-rooted child sequence beneath its named predecessor root; parent_path is its exact held input directory and parent device inode join; all four copied-source vnodes are pairwise distinct and none equals a root vnode
predecessor_source_copy_continuity_join_.watch_lifetime: each file and held input-parent entry watch arms after exclusive copy fsync chmod reopen and before pre-action inventory; all remain armed and continuously drained across all four compiler actions pair audits selection and final revalidation
predecessor_source_copy_continuity_join_.compiler_input_rule: the four predecessor compiler argv source operands are exactly these held copied-source paths; no compiler action names or opens the implementation repository source paths

action_root_sequence_join_table.step_rule: initial observation equals first action_root_continuity before fields; every prior post-reap equals next before; final post-reap equals terminal observation

outer_launcher_receipt_join_table.incomplete_predicates: controller and controller_generation are null until observed; completed action_transcript entries remain complete; failed_action records exact next Q01 and phase with nullable A02 action K01 and S01 fields plus available-prefix hash; retain bounded raw controller stdout/stderr prefixes every entered frame/digest fresh pre-signal snapshots membership census signal status reap/drain/probe observations and exact B01 frame hash or null; OBSERVED post-signal probes remain INCOMPLETE at the finite absolute horizon and are never reinterpreted as conservation or B01
